title: [Strategy] 12-minute rule: pick the trend side with 3 minutes left (BTC 15m)

fields.Market: Kalshi KXBTC15M; Polymarket US BTC Up/Down 15m
fields.The claim, in the source's own terms: A TikTok creator watches a 15-minute BTC contract for 12 minutes, then picks UP or DOWN by the current trend with 3 minutes left, and says it wins.
fields.Original sources: TikTok video found by Jacob (link to add). Original not yet verified by Perplexity. Unknown whether the creator sells anything.
fields.Exact rules (as testable as possible): Source: entry at 12:00 elapsed, side = 'trend' (UNSPECIFIED). Lab pre-registration (data/15m/PREREG.md): PRIMARY = AGREE, i.e. bet only when BTC is on the winning side of the target AND moved that way over the last 60s. Entry = ask ~60s later, Kalshi taker fee, held to settlement.
fields.Supporting evidence: None checkable yet. Legacy 5m data at the same 80%-elapsed point hinted at it (not evidence: known bugs, no delay).
fields.Weaknesses and red flags: Trend rule unspecified. The trend side is usually already the favourite at 75-90c, so it wins often by construction; profit needs the market to under-price continuation. Fees and delay not mentioned by the source.
fields.How could we paper-test it at $0?: Phase 1 (running): Kalshi historical backtest, backtest15.py -> data/15m/report.md (exploratory). Phase 2 (if justified): forward paper test on Polymarket US 15m, 300 trades.

title: [Strategy] Polybot model edge: buy when our win chance beats the price by 6-15% (BTC 5m)

fields.The claim, in the source's own terms: Our random-walk model (volatility x1.4, capped at 88%) finds rounds where the market misprices the outcome by 6-15% after fees at 4:00 or 3:30 left.
fields.Original sources: Internal: agent.py v18+ (frozen model rw-m1.4-c0.88-b15), team board history.
fields.Exact rules (as testable as possible): One ticket per round max; 6% <= edge <= 15% after fee; no ticket after a spike or in chop; re-priced right before sending; simulated fill = ask at +30s if within the limit.
fields.Supporting evidence: None yet: the v18 forward experiment started 2026-11-25. Out-of-sample calibration on legacy data was honest up to ~70% and overconfident above.
fields.Weaknesses and red flags: A big gap with the market is often a warning, not an edge. Coinbase is not the settlement index (BRTI). Few tickets per day, so 300 will take a while.
fields.How could we paper-test it at $0?: Running: forward paper test, report.md 'Research report: experiment v18+ only'.

title: [Strategy] Buy the cheap (~10c) side for a late bounce (BTC 5m)

fields.The claim, in the source's own terms: Cheap longshot contracts pay 9-10x, so buying the ~10c side near the end catches enough reversals to profit.
fields.Original sources: Common claim in prediction-market social posts; no single original source verified.
fields.Exact rules (as testable as possible): Buy the side priced ~10c in the final minutes; hold to settlement.
fields.Supporting evidence: Lab backtest (exploratory, early polybot data) found no edge: longshots won about as often as priced or less, before fees.
fields.Weaknesses and red flags: Longshot bias usually runs the other way (cheap contracts are over-priced). Exploratory result on early data only.
fields.How could we paper-test it at $0?: Could be re-run on Kalshi 15m history with the same machinery as backtest15.py if the team wants a cleaner test.

title: [Strategy] Two-sided market making: buy Up and Down for under $1 combined

fields.The claim, in the source's own terms: Top 5-minute wallets rest orders on both sides and lock in the spread when Up + Down costs less than $1.
fields.Original sources: Public wallet histories on the Polymarket leaderboard (researched 2026-11-25).
fields.Exact rules (as testable as possible): Post limit orders on both sides so the combined cost is under $1; profit = $1 minus the cost, if both fill.
fields.Supporting evidence: Observed in public top-wallet trade histories (L1).
fields.Weaknesses and red flags: Needs resting orders that actually fill (queue position, adverse selection: you get filled when the market moves against you). Speed and capital game.
fields.How could we paper-test it at $0?: Not honestly with top-of-book snapshots: a paper test can't know whether a resting order would have filled. Untestable at $0 for now.
